run_image_retrieval_evaluation: run image retrieval evaluation on revisited Paris or Oxford datasets using DINO pretrained weights
run_multiscale_retrieval: run image retrieval with multiscale feature extraction on the roxford5k dataset using vit_small
create_oxford_paris_dataset: create an OxfordParisDataset instance for train or query split with a custom transform and image size
